title: transient-latency-grace-eval-gate-and-delayed-fail-ci-adapter
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Some recent CI failures were caused by short-lived telemetry blips and delayed metrics ingestion, producing noisy hard-fails on prompt-set regression checks. This PR introduces a transient-latency-grace eval gate paired with a delayed-fail CI adapter to reduce flakiness while preserving prompt regression sensitivity. The change has three parts: 1) temporal_grace_window: a new gate that computes an exponential-decay weighted rolling window of metric deltas and allows transient deviations inside a configurable grace period before escalating; 2) delayed-fail CI adapter: a CI hook that, when a gate trips, postpones hard failure for a configurable backoff (with jitter) to allow late-arriving telemetry and cross-run reconciliation; 3) test and telemetry: new unit and integration tests plus a smoke replay harness to validate behavior under delayed ingestion and partial fold events. Design notes: the grace window uses half-life semantics (configurable, default 10 minutes) and a maximum allowed transient exceedance quota to avoid masking persistent regressions. The delayed-fail adapter records run metadata and schedules a follow-up evaluation job (with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts) if the initial run fails due to a grace-window transient. If the subsequent replay confirms regression, the original CI run marks hard-fail and notifies the on-call via the existing alerting pipeline. Rollout plan: feature gated by eval.feature.temporal_grace flag, start with opt-in projects and a 2-week observation period, then flip to default on the eva l-harness primary repo if metrics show reduced noisy failures without regression detection loss. Testing performed: local unit tests, CI matrix across Python 3.9/3.11, integration replay with synthetic delayed telemetry traces, and a canary on the 'redwood' repo for 48 hours. Backwards compatibility: config defaults preserve current strict behavior unless flag enabled. Related work: follows ENG-4390 (late-arrival reconciler) but differs by applying a soft grace policy with replay-first delayed escalation rather than immediate reconciliation. Checklist: - add temporal grace gate implementation - add CI adapter and scheduler integration - add unit and integration tests - add docs for flag and config - add migration note for ops and runbook Observability: new metrics introduced eval.grace_window.exceedance_count, eval.delayed_fail.replays_scheduled, and a debug trace emitted for gated events. This description is a single continuous string to match PR page formatting.
